meta.purpose: Test whether colour beyond a functional floor adds useful scanning value. Holds chroma as low as WCAG floors and the distance matrix tolerate.
meta.tradeoffs: Lowest chromatic attention hypothesis; weakest categorical cue and smallest CVD headroom. Nominal area-weighted spectral output is evaluated separately and is not inferred from chroma. Diagnostics are deliberately exempt from the restraint.
